Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - C.C. No. 2608/2023

Dear Ms. Tiwari,

Thank you for meeting us on 16/06/2024 about your dispute with Orchid Constructions. As we understand it, the flat was handed over with serious construction defects. The matter is listed before the Thane District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

Our advice is to commission a structural audit report on the defects before the first hearing. Please collect photographs of the defects and a structural audit report and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 9,29,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
